compiler.default_source_gate: Refuses selected compiler when recorded/current source digests differ, before remote effects or a receipt. Actual refusal retained.
compiler.exploratory_scope: Own-code port parity against fixed supplied package bytes; no matching-main toolchain or current package emission claim

preserved_admission: Enumerate every profile in catalog-6445ee0050.json in its declared order
Require package schema and matching slug; every product is a safe basename with its declared lowercase SHA256
Deduplicate by actual SPIR-V SHA256 while retaining every profile/entry owner and order
Generate bad magic and the first OpCompositeConstruct result-type-zero control in Coax from the actual first program
Check every native observation's file/hash/kind/owners/exit/stdout/stderr against the complete retained same-input result

native_validator.transport: Literal checked SSH/SCP arguments; existing installed SDK invoked directly with timeout, no remote loops or JSON logic

bad_magic.stderr: error: line 0: Invalid SPIR-V magic number.

policy_qualification.independent_controls: Exact little-endian fixture bytes, first-composite selection with two composites and a no-operand instruction, short/misaligned/truncated instruction refusal before output changes, every-byte ASCII/hex membership, source path bounds and separation of validator refusal from SSH/timeouts
policy_qualification.retained_reds: Missing-procedure red and intermediate surviving mutants retained. Boundary checks and an observable bounded path scan closed survivors without waivers.

source_identities.runtime_fence: Selected compiler/image/digest, full Coax dependency closure, native adapters, tool wrapper, snapshot, baseline, every package manifest/product and generated payload. Before/after compiler-source digest and file hashes unchanged.

limits: Supplied historical package bytes are pinned independently of build provenance; no current package compiler emission is inferred.
This checks native SPIR-V validity only; pipeline creation, GPU execution, image qualification and release readiness remain separate.
The selected compiler is explicitly historical. Default source matching remains enforced, and the successful observation is named exploratory.
